scope: Engineering experiment; no product service-level promise
durability: process-crash on functioning OS/filesystem; rename without data fsync in both candidates
primary_boundary: ready real Google Chrome pointer dispatch T0 to unchanged watcher stdout TW
actual_agent_boundary: TS unavailable until a supported isolated host input receipt is recorded
queue_boundary: UI acknowledgement upper bound; storage acknowledgement TQ unavailable without separate instrumentation
percentile: nearest rank, ceil(n*q)-1, successful values only alongside full attempt denominator
primary_benefit: Chrome-to-watcher p95 improvement of at least 20 percent and 20 ms
alternative_benefit: at least 30 percent in a dominant measured resource/recovery cost or demonstrated removal of an installation failure class
uncertainty: paired block bootstrap, deterministic seed, 95 percent percentile interval; fewer than five pairs is inconclusive
eligibility: All essential conformance, required real Chrome/native/host/OS and compatible rollback evidence before adoption. Missing evidence stays unavailable or not-run.
baseline_feasibility: JS0 visible Google Chrome 30/30, p50 39.165 ms, p95 89.284 ms; diagnostic sample only. Geometry preparation removed from timed locator auto-wait; prior attempts retained.
